generation.scope: A finite Frobenius four-edge point-fiber graph cannot be a smooth integral rational quartic with disjoint finite residual. Seven mixed relations give a balanced quadratic syzygy bundle and a five-dimensional full cubic overlap. The required four-dimensional suboverlap would force a Hankel determinant simultaneously zero and nonzero. Smooth integral quartics with disjoint residual are elliptic with isolated length four.

open_mathematics: Treat smooth plane cubic point components and the nonplanar twisted cubic; use the restricted ternary relations on plane graphs and the binary four-factor tensor on the twisted cubic. Other singular, reducible, nonreduced and finite high-rank graphs remain open.
